title: Northgate Memberships Tenure Terms for Settlement Restocking on Special Order Returns
content:
Membership loyalty terms for the settlement restocking fee that Northgate Purchases & Returns charges on a changed-mind return of Northgate Special Order merchandise for a consumer-segment membership. Tenure is read from the opened date on the presenting membership's Northgate Memberships record.

## Membership tenure points

When the membership was opened 96 months or more before today, 2 percentage points are taken off the rate; when it was opened 60 months or more but less than 96 months before today, 1 point is taken off; otherwise nothing is taken off.

The membership is the one presented on the purchase. The points taken off reduce the single percentage that is applied to the changed-mind refund.

| Membership opened before today | Points taken off the rate |
|---|---|
| 96 months or more | 2 |
| 60 months or more, less than 96 months | 1 |
| less than 60 months | none |

## Readings (hypothetical memberships)

- Opened 96 months before today: 2 points off.
- Opened 95 months before today: 1 point off.
- Opened 60 months before today: 1 point off.
- Opened 59 months before today: nothing off.
